subject: Air-gapped deployment: validation schedule, rollback plan & HW acceptance
messages:
From: Evan Cole <evan.cole@genomixedge.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: SFO-IT <itops@genomixedge.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Air-gapped deployment: validation schedule, rollback plan & HW acceptance

Karthik,

Thanks again for today's product call — helpful demo and overview. A couple of follow-ups from our onsite engineering team:

- Confirm the expected maintenance cadence for offline firmware/OS/serving runtime updates.
- Clarify physical media transfer workflow (signed checksum process, handoff at secure desk).
- Confirm whether Redwood provides a spare parts kit (GPU/PSU/rescue USB) or if we need to source locally.

We are leaning toward Private (air-gapped) but need to validate patches/upgrades without internet and have a clear rollback/playback plan before signing the SOW.

Attached: initial site survey filled (partial), and your airgap HW spec we printed.

Next steps from our side: schedule a 1.5h validation call with SFO-IT and our CISO on Wed or Thu. Can you propose two slots?

Thanks,
Evan
VP Engineering
GenomixEdge

Attachments: site-survey-template.xlsx (partial), airgap-hw-specs.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Evan Cole <evan.cole@genomixedge.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Air-gapped deployment: validation schedule, rollback plan & HW acceptance

Evan — great to hear the call was useful. Appreciate the concrete list. Quick answers inline and a proposed plan below.

1) Maintenance cadence and upgrades (offline)
- Typical customer cadence: quarterly security firmware + monthly critical hotfixes for the runtime. For air-gapped installs we bundle releases into an "update bundle" delivered as signed artifacts (tar.gz + detached signature).
- For your initial acceptance we recommend a staged validation: baseline image -> apply update bundle in a staging lane -> smoke tests -> production lane. Total downtime target: 30-90 minutes depending on long-running KV/cache warmups.

2) Physical media transfer workflow
- We supply checksums and PGP-signed manifests. Customers perform an integrity check on import and sign the import event in the audit log (we can provide the import CLI wrapper).
- Hand-off model: courier to secure desk (you can also use your internal KMS to re-sign if required).

3) Spare parts kit
- Redwood includes a recommended spare-parts list in the HW spec but does not ship physical spares by default for on-prem. We can offer an optional spare-kits add-on (same-day ship from our partner) in the SOW.

Proposed validation call slots (PT):
- Wed 2027-06-09 10:00–11:30 PT
- Thu 2027-06-10 13:00–14:30 PT

Deliverables we'll bring to validation: detailed rollback-playbook-v1.md, a scripted offline update demo, and a copy of the signed bundle verification steps.

Action items I will take this week:
- Share rollback-playbook-v1.md and a condensed acceptance checklist (hardware + software) — by EOD Tue.
- Confirm spare-kits pricing and lead time — by Wed.

If Wed 10:00 PT works for your team I'll send an invite.

Thanks,
Karthik
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: SFO-IT <itops@genomixedge.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Evan Cole <evan.cole@genomixedge.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 08:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Air-gapped deployment: validation schedule, rollback plan & HW acceptance

Karthik / Evan —

Wed 10:00 PT works for the SFO IT and CISO team. Two quick expansion items to bake into the playbook:

- Hardware liveness probes: we need the exact IPMI/iLO commands you use for health checks and their expected outputs; offline SNMP is not an option for us.
- OS-level rollback trigger: define a deterministic check that can automatically switch back to last-known-good image if more than X failed probes in Y timeframe (we're thinking X=3, Y=5m).

Also note procurement requires spare-parts lead time in the SOW; please include warranty and RMA SLA options explicitly.

Thanks,
SFO Site Ops (on behalf of CISO)

Attachment: prefilled-site-survey.xlsx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Evan Cole <evan.cole@genomixedge.com>, SFO-IT <itops@genomixedge.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 17:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Air-gapped deployment: validation schedule, rollback plan & HW acceptance

Thanks for confirming — calendar invite sent for Wed 2027-06-09 10:00–11:30 PT (includes dial-in and a shared drive with artifacts). Summary and immediate next steps below.

Summary of what Redwood will present at the validation call:
- Offline update demo: how we apply signed bundles and verify checksums (scripted, ~20m).
- Rollback playbook: deterministic health checks + automated fallback (we'll demo failover into last-known-good snapshot in staging).
- HW acceptance checklist: power cycling, IPMI health, GPU ECC check, and spare-parts list.

Pre-call deliverables (shared Drive link): https://redwood.app/s/rdw-DOC-1234
- rollback-playbook-v1.md (attached in drive)
- airgap-hw-specs.pdf (full BOM and spare kit options)
- site-survey-template.xlsx (completed copy)

Decisions requested on the call:
1) Acceptable rollback thresholds (defaults we suggest: X=3 failed probes in Y=5m).
2) Whether Redwood provisioning should include partner-sourced spare-kits (we'll quote).
3) Confirmation of who signs and timestamps the secure-media import event (GenomixEdge secops or a 3rd-party accredited courier).

Please reply with any last-minute agenda items. Looking forward to the call.

-Karthik
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: rollback-playbook-v1.md, airgap-hw-specs.pdf, site-survey-template.xlsx
